meta.title: Vu Thanh Bay | Fullstack Engineer
meta.description: Fullstack engineer, 8 years building for the web with Vue / Nuxt. Built a multi-site retail platform now in production: 1,060 PRs merged, 15+ services integrated.
meta.ogDescription: Fullstack engineer. Built a multi-site retail platform now in production, end to end.

hero.title: Hi, I'm Bay.
hero.lead: I turn messy retail operations into software that holds up: orders, inventory, payments, shipping. 8 years with Vue / Nuxt, now building the Node.js and PostgreSQL side too.

glance.title: Frontend, backend, and the business behind them.
glance.statPrs: PRs merged into the new platform
glance.s1Text: The thinkpro.vn V4 storefront hit a perfect performance score on both mobile and desktop.
glance.s2Text: Orders, inventory, warranty, marketplaces, shipping, on PostgreSQL, Redis and job queues. I authored most of the new platform.
glance.s3Text: AI writes code under rules I set. I own the architecture and business decisions, and review every change before merging.

exp.title:
Two systems I built.
Both running in production.
exp.feText: Built across 2 generations, Nuxt 2 then Nuxt 3, writing about three quarters of the code myself.
exp.feCheck1: Performance score 100/100 on both mobile and desktop
exp.feCheck2: Technical SEO with the marketing team: structured data, sitemaps, Merchant Center
exp.feCheck3: Internal CMS, the GoodSpace storefront, front ends for NiceDesign
exp.leadText: One Nuxt 4 codebase on Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis and BullMQ, replacing the legacy Laravel / MySQL system for 4 sites and 1 admin.
exp.leadCheck1: Author of 1,060 / 1,482 merged PRs, 260+ database tables
exp.leadCheck3: Handled the full data migration from the legacy system myself
exp.azoomText: CMS running Azoom.jp, lower Google API costs for carparking.jp
exp.amelaText: Base CMS reused across outsourcing projects

gather.label: 1,060 PRs merged
gather.caption: PRs merged into the new platform, about 72% of the whole project, in 9 months.

projects.title: What I did, and what it changed.
projects.p1Text: Four brands share one platform and one admin, instead of a separate system for each site.
projects.p2Text: Optimized images, fonts, layout and responsiveness page by page; speed measured from real users.
projects.p3Title: Find the real bottleneck, then fix it
projects.p3Text: Grey bar is before, colored bar is after. Customers move faster, developers wait less.
projects.p4Text: Marketplaces, shipping, payments, Zalo, Lark, MISA, plus automated reconciliation for accounting.
projects.p5Title: An AI workflow for the team
projects.p5Text: AI must read the real code before editing, risky operations are blocked automatically, and the whole team shares it.
projects.p6Text: A Japanese product, outsourcing projects, accounting software. That was the groundwork for understanding many kinds of business.

contact.title: Let's build something that actually ships.
contact.text: Looking for a Fullstack role at a product company in Hanoi.
